categories.main_business_segments: RocKontrol Technology Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in IoT big data technology with a focus on smart environmental protection, smart dual-carbon (carbon peak and carbon neutrality), and smart city businesses. The company provides integrated IoT-based hardware and software products, solutions, and big data services mainly to government agencies, state-owned enterprises, and platform companies. It also develops and operates platforms for environmental monitoring, carbon management, and urban intelligent management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies including IoT sensing and edge computing embedded products, the 'Haidongqing' IoT database platform, blockchain-based cloud chain data sharing platform, data security management systems, AI algorithms and platforms, and digital twin visualization technology. It employs AI, big data, blockchain, cloud computing, and edge computing technologies, with proprietary AI models and large-scale environmental dual-carbon models trained on extensive datasets. Manufacturing includes embedded hardware for environmental monitoring and smart sensors, with software developed under mature CMMI5 processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are government departments, platform companies, and state-owned enterprises primarily in environmental protection, urban management, and energy sectors. The company also serves industrial enterprises, financial institutions, and individual users in the carbon market and green finance sectors. Its markets cover ecological environment monitoring, carbon emission management, smart city infrastructure, and related digital services across multiple verticals.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with business coverage spanning major regions including Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin, Chongqing, Taiyuan, Hohhot, and over 150 cities nationwide. It has established localized service bases in regions such as the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei area, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and other key urban clusters. No significant overseas operations are reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: RocKontrol operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IoT and environmental data value chain. It develops and manufactures IoT sensing devices and embedded hardware, builds and operates data platforms and cloud services, and provides software solutions and data analytics services to end customers. It also engages in system integration and ongoing operation and maintenance services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company strategically focuses on advancing IoT big data, AI, blockchain, and large model technologies to enhance smart environmental protection, dual-carbon management, and smart city applications. It emphasizes productization of core technologies, data asset management, and platform-based service models. R&D priorities include AI algorithm optimization, environmental monitoring models, carbon data platforms, and integrated smart city solutions, supported by a mature R&D system and national-level research centers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales (hardware and software), engineering construction contracts, and ongoing operation and maintenance (O&M) service contracts. The company also earns income from data operation services, consulting, and licensing of technology platforms. Government subsidies and investment income contribute to non-operating revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: RocKontrol is positioned as a leading innovator in China's IoT big data and smart environmental protection sectors, with recognized core technologies and national-level certifications. It competes with large technology firms entering the IoT and environmental data markets, including industry giants like Huawei. The company leverages its strong data assets, government relationships, and specialized dual-carbon solutions to maintain competitive advantages in niche verticals.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 300 million, a 6.81% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 103 million, though the loss narrowed compared to prior years. Total assets stood at around RMB 1.03 billion, with net assets of approximately RMB 720 million. R&D investment accounted for 17.52% of revenue, reflecting a strategic focus on innovation despite a reduction in R&D personnel and expenses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: RocKontrol emphasizes its comprehensive IoT cloud-chain big data platform integrating sensing, blockchain, AI, and large model technologies to provide precise, intelligent environmental and carbon management solutions. Its unique value lies in deep data accumulation, proprietary AI models tailored for environmental and dual-carbon applications, and a full lifecycle service capability from hardware to data analytics. The company’s products enable governments and enterprises to achieve scientific pollution control, carbon emission reduction, and smart urban management with high accuracy and operational efficiency.
